messages:
oliver: FYI opened a tiny PR adding an air-gapped provisioning checklist + three KMS/HSM sample snippets (systemd, firewalld, PKCS#11 probe). github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1501 :wave:
sasha: linking. Can you paste the firewalld rules here so we can sanity-check syntax for RHEL customers?
oliver: sure. minimal example we added: `firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8443/tcp && firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=22/tcp && firewall-cmd --reload` 
kim: also add a short note about nftables vs firewalld on newer systems. Maybe include an nft translation example?
oliver: added translation snippet:
`# nftables equivalent
nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport 8443 accept`
sasha: for the KMS TLS note, avoid "expose certs" wording. Use: "KMS must present a cert chain signed by the customer's root CA; private key material must remain on the HSM or restricted KMS host."
kim: include an openssl SNI check example so support can triage TLS issues quickly.
oliver: added: `openssl s_client -connect kms.internal:8443 -servername kms.internal -showcerts` and a quick PKCS#11 probe: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/*pkcs11* -L 2>/dev/null || pkcs11-tool --module /usr/local/lib/*pkcs11* -L 2>/dev/null`
sasha: can we include a tiny systemd socket+service pair for the HSM agent? Some customers prefer socket activation.
oliver: pasted minimal pair in the PR (kept it short). Also added an scp fallback and a sha256 verification example for airgap image transfer: `scp mirror:/tmp/images.tar.gz /tmp/ && sha256sum -c /tmp/images.tar.gz.sha256`
kim: small vendor note: mention PKCS#11 path differences for Yubico vs Thales so readers know to check /opt vendor dirs.
oliver: added vendor hint and a one-liner to search common paths: `for p in /usr/lib/* /usr/local/lib/* /opt/*; do ls $p | grep -i pkcs11 || true; done`
deploy-bot: CI: docs lint passed for PR 1501.
docs-bot: PR 1501: label set to docs-review. 2 reviewers requested: @sasha, @kim.
sasha: I can review later today; focusing on wording and the firewall matrix.
kim: will take networking + HSM wording. If it's just wording + small snippets should be quick.
oliver: thanks both. If approved I'll merge after CI and backport a 1-line note to the migration checklist for sales/SE copy.
